The long-running historical drama prepares to close out its decade-long story with new challenges and emotional turns ahead. Outlander Season 8 comes out on Starz in March 2026 Starz has officially announced the premiere date for Outlander’s final season. The eighth and concluding installment of the time-travel romance will debut on March 6, 2026, marking the beginning of the end for Claire and Jamie Fraser’s story. The news comes months after the show wrapped its seventh season in January 2025. The series is based on Diana Gabaldon’s bestselling novels. It stars Caitríona Balfe as Claire Randall Fraser, a WWII nurse who travels back in time, and Sam Heughan as Jamie Fraser, an 18th-century Scottish warrior. The eighth season will feature 10 episodes and bring Outlander’s total to 101, making it Starz’s longest-running original series. Starz teased in a press release, “Jamie and Claire soon find the war has followed them home to Fraser’s Ridge, now a thriving settlement that has grown and flourished in their absence.” It continued, “With new arrivals and changes made during their years away, the Frasers are confronted with the question of what they are willing to sacrifice for the place they call home and, more importantly, what they would sacrifice to stay together.” Showrunner Matthew B. Roberts discussed his approach to the final season at San Diego Comic-Con, stating, “The idea for the last season was to not try to top everything we’ve done but to just do a really good season of Outlander and make [the story] work.” Actress Sophie Skelton, who plays Brianna Fraser, added, “We’ve surpassed the books at this point. The writers have done such an incredible job of keeping that nostalgia but just injecting some stuff that you don’t expect.” (via Entertainment Weekly ) The Outlander franchise will continue beyond the main series. Starz has already renewed the prequel Blood of My Blood for a second season. All Rights Reserved Outlander's Final Season Gets Premiere Date At Starz — Find Out When Jamie And Claire's Last Adventure Will Get Underway Calendar Every New Show Christmas Movies News TV Streaming Reviews Exclusives Features Newsletter Television Outlander's Final Season Gets Premiere Date At Starz — Find Out When Jamie And Claire's Last Adventure Will Get Underway By Kimberly Roots Nov. 10, 2025 12:30 pm EST Steel yerselves, Outlander faithful: We now have a premiere date for the time-travel drama's final season. Season 8 of the Starz series will premiere on Friday, March 6, 2026, TVLine has learned. As the final run of episodes gets underway, the official synopsis tells us, "Jamie and Claire soon find the war has followed them home to Fraser's Ridge, now a thriving settlement that has grown and flourished in their absence. With new arrivals and changes made during their years away, the Frasers are confronted with the question of what they are willing to sacrifice for the place they call home and, more importantly, what they would sacrifice to stay together. While the Frasers keep a united front against outside intruders, family secrets finally coming to light threaten to tear them apart from the inside. Although they've left the war for America's freedom behind, their fight for Fraser's Ridge has only just begun." Starz also released a new poster for the upcoming season, which you can see below. As Caitríona Balfe's Claire and Sam Heughan's Jamie draw each other near, it reads: "Outlander: The Final Season: Past. Present. Forever." We first got a sense of what's to come in July, when Starz released the first "Outlander" final season trailer, which you can watch above. James Alexander Malcolm MacKenzie Fraser has cheated death more times than we can count, but still: The footage at the top of this post gives us serious pause. "I've been reading Frank's book," Jamie says in the teaser trailer. What does it say, a worried-looking Claire asks? "War is coming to the back country," he replies gravely, "and that James Fraser dies in it." Are there likely more than one James Frasers in America at the time? Probably! Has a historical document been wrong before in this series ? Absolutely! Do either of those facts do anything to assuage our concern for Big Red as we head into the show's swan song? Nope, not a bit! The exchange comes near the end of a video highlighting the series' decade-plus run on Starz. When series star Sam Heughan finished his final work on the season in March , he teased that "It's going to be quite, quite an emotional one" and promised fans "I know you're going to love it." Do you have thoughts and feelings about the final season of "Outlander"? Let us know in the comments! The eighth and final season of Outlander premieres on Starz on Friday, March 6, 2026. Sam Heughan and Caitríona Balfe return as Jamie and Claire Fraser, the couple at the center of the star-crossed, toe-curling, time-traveling romance fans have followed for the last eleven years. Fans got their first taste of goodbye to the show, based on the books by Diana Gabaldon , in the first trailer for the final season that premiered back in September. Beyond Balfe and Heughan, Sophie Skelton will return as Brianna MacKenzie, Richard Rankin returns as Roger MacKenzie, along with John Bell as Young Ian Murray, David Berry as Lord John Grey, Charles Vandervaart as William Ransom, and Izzy Meikle-Small as Rachel Murray. The logline for Season 8 is as follows: "As Season 8 begins, Jamie and Claire soon find the war has followed them home to Fraser’s Ridge, now a thriving settlement that has grown and flourished in their absence. With new arrivals and changes made during their years away, the Frasers are confronted with the question of what they are willing to sacrifice for the place they call home and, more importantly, what they would sacrifice to stay together. While the Frasers keep a united front against outside intruders, family secrets finally coming to light threaten to tear them apart from the inside. Although they’ve left the war for America’s freedom behind, their fight for Fraser’s Ridge has only just begun." What's Next For the Frasers' Story? Earlier this year, Outlander: Blood of My Blood premiered. The prequel focused on the dual love stories of Jamie's parents and Claire's parents. The series was renewed for a second season even before it premiered in August. Harriet Slater and Jamie Roy play Jamie's parents, Ellen MacKenzie and Brian Fraser; Hermione Corfield and Jeremy Irvine play Claire's parents, Julia Moriston and Henry Beauchamp. The series saw younger versions of Outlander favorites, along with new characters that help build these two love stories that eventually converge in the union of Jamie and Claire. When Roy spoke with Collider earlier this year, he said he's received support from a likely source: the actor playing his son. He told Collider that Sam Heughan's support "is everything." He explained: "One night, he texted me and asked me, 'How are you doing? I know this is a lot, but you’re smashing it.' That was something so simple, but it meant so much to me because he doesn’t have to do that. He could easily just go on with his life and go onto the next thing. That support and care really meant a lot to me. It’s been less advice and more just a pillar to lean on and give that support. He’s always said to me to just enjoy it and to really take my time with everything because it passes so quickly." Indeed, as Roy says, time has passed quickly. After nearly 12 years, Outlander 's final season premieres March 6, 2026. Check out the trailer for the final season above. Stay with Collider for the latest updates. The eighth and final season of Outlander premieres on Starz on Friday, March 6, 2026. Sam Heughan and Caitríona Balfe return as Jamie and Claire Fraser, the couple at the center of the star-crossed, toe-curling, time-traveling romance fans have followed for the last eleven years. Fans got their first taste of goodbye to the show, based on the books by Diana Gabaldon , in the first trailer for the final season that premiered back in September. Beyond Balfe and Heughan, Sophie Skelton will return as Brianna MacKenzie, Richard Rankin returns as Roger MacKenzie, along with John Bell as Young Ian Murray, David Berry as Lord John Grey, Charles Vandervaart as William Ransom, and Izzy Meikle-Small as Rachel Murray. The logline for Season 8 is as follows: "As Season 8 begins, Jamie and Claire soon find the war has followed them home to Fraser’s Ridge, now a thriving settlement that has grown and flourished in their absence. With new arrivals and changes made during their years away, the Frasers are confronted with the question of what they are willing to sacrifice for the place they call home and, more importantly, what they would sacrifice to stay together. While the Frasers keep a united front against outside intruders, family secrets finally coming to light threaten to tear them apart from the inside. Although they’ve left the war for America’s freedom behind, their fight for Fraser’s Ridge has only just begun. " What's Next For the Frasers' Story? Earlier this year, Outlander: Blood of My Blood premiered. The prequel focused on the dual love stories of Jamie's parents and Claire's parents. The series was renewed for a second season even before it premiered in August. Harriet Slater and Jamie Roy play Jamie's parents, Ellen MacKenzie and Brian Fraser; Hermione Corfield and Jeremy Irvine play Claire's parents, Julia Moriston and Henry Beauchamp. The series saw younger versions of Outlander favorites, along with new characters that help build these two love stories that eventually converge in the union of Jamie and Claire. When Roy spoke with Collider earlier this year, he said he's received support from a likely source: the actor playing his son. He told Collider that Sam Heughan's support "is everything. " He explained: "One night, he texted me and asked me, 'How are you doing? I know this is a lot, but you’re smashing it. ' That was something so simple, but it meant so much to me because he doesn’t have to do that. He could easily just go on with his life and go onto the next thing. That support and care really meant a lot to me. It’s been less advice and more just a pillar to lean on and give that support. He’s always said to me to just enjoy it and to really take my time with everything because it passes so quickly. " Indeed, as Roy says, time has passed quickly. After nearly 12 years, Outlander 's final season premieres March 6, 2026. Check out the trailer for the final season above. Stay with Collider for the latest updates. Published Wed, 19 Nov 2025 21:07:04 -0600 by Ray Flook | Comments Article Summary Jeffrey Dean Morgan posted a behind-the-scenes look at himself and Lauren Cohan during The Walking Dead: Dead City Season 3 filming. Maggie and Negan unite to build Manhattan's first safe post-apocalyptic community in the new season. Seth Hoffman joins as showrunner, promising major changes and intense drama for The Walking Dead: Dead City. New cast members Aimee Garcia, Jimmi Simpson, and Raúl Castillo bring fresh faces and intrigue to Season 3. In the upcoming third season of Showrunner Seth Hoffman and AMC's Jeffrey Dean Morgan and Lauren Cohan -starring The Walking Dead: Dead City , Maggie (Cohan) and Negan (Morgan) finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse. However, when chaos begins to arise in the city, they are forced to question whether they have learned from their old wounds or whether their dark past will spell doom for the entire city. Based on that official description, it's pretty clear that the third season will be upping the show's game in some very big ways. But even as production rolls on, Morgan and Cohan haven't forgotten to check in on social media with the fans to let everyone know how things are going. Plus, there's no such thing as having too many behind-the-scenes looks at Cohan and Morgan together. Lauren Cohan as Maggie Rhee, Jeffrey Dean Morgan as Negan – The Walking Dead: Dead City _ Season 2, Episode 8 – Photo Credit: Robert Clark/AMC "Keep meaning to throw some pics of the lovely [Lauren Cohan] up here. Thank you for pestering me… here she be. The coolest co-star ever. Happy almost thanksgiving. Big love to all y'all from set of Dead City season 3. Gonna be a fun one. Xxjd," Morgan shared as the caption to his Instagram post on Wednesday night – here's a look: View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jeffrey Dean Morgan (@jeffreydeanmorgan) Show Full IG Post Aimee Garcia 's ( Lucifer, Criminal Minds: Evolution ) Renata is described as "a disarmingly charming leader with a natural ability to win people over with her optimism and convivial personality." Jimmi Simpson ( Dark Matter, It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia ) is set for the role of Dillard, though additional details were not released. Raúl Castillo ( Task, Army of the Dead ) has joined the series as a series regular in the role of Luis, though no additional details were offered. Here's a look at the announcement that hit social media back in July that announced that Season 3 was on the way: NYC isn't done with Negan and Maggie just yet… 🍎 #DeadCity will be returning for SEASON 3, with #TWD veteran Seth Hoffman joining as showrunner! pic.twitter.com/GaTVvJrxdx — The Walking Dead (@WalkingDead_AMC) July 16, 2025 Show Full Tweet AMC's The Walking Dead: Dead City follows Maggie (Cohan) and Negan (Morgan) traveling into a post-apocalyptic Manhattan long ago cut off from the mainland, on a mission to save Hershel (Logan Kim ). The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made New York City their own world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror. In season two, in the growing war for control of Manhattan, Maggie and Negan find themselves trapped on opposite sides. As their paths intertwine, they come to see that the way out for both is more complicated and harrowing than they ever imagined. Along with Cohan and Morgan, the second season starred Gaius Charles, Zeljko Ivanek (aka The Croat), Karina Ortiz, Jonathan Higginbotham, Mahina Napoleon , and Logan Kim , with Kim Coates ( Sons of Anarchy ), Keir Gilchrist ( Atypical, It Follows ), Dascha Polanco ( Orange Is the New Black, Poker Face ), Jake Weary ( Oh, Canada, How to Blow Up a Pipeline ), and Pooya Mohseni ( Law & Order: SVU, See You Then ) joining the cast for the second season. Cohan, Morgan, TWD CCO Scott M. Gimple , Showrunner Eli Jorné , and Brian Bockrath serve as executive producers . Enjoyed this? Please share on social media! If you're struggling to decide what to watch, I'm here to lend a hand. These are three shows I think are great, so I hope you enjoy them too. Since it's Halloween, I've chosen shows with a darker or spooky edge, though you can easily appreciate them year-round too. 3 Narcos: Mexico Narcos: Mexico is a companion series to Narcos , the latter of which primarily focuses on the war on drugs in Colombia and the DEA agents trying to bring down Pablo Escobar. If you haven't seen the main show, which debuted in 2015 and spanned three seasons, I strongly urge you to watch it. It's not required viewing to make sense of Mexico , but it's simply one of the best Netflix shows ; it's a dramatization of real events, which makes it even more engaging. As you can determine from its name, Narcos: Mexico moves the focus from Colombia to North America. The show is about the inception and growth of Mexico's drug trade. Diego Luna stars as Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, leader of a powerful cartel, and Michael Peña portrays Kiki Camarena, a real-life DEA agent who moved with his family from the US to Guadalajara. The show evolves over the course of three seasons with different characters coming and going, but it remains utterly gripping throughout. Narcos: Mexico immediately hooks you with its intelligent writing. The show is dark, shocking, and violent, as you would expect from its subject matter, but it's also surprisingly funny, in part because of how absurd some of the people and situations are. It's also visually stunning, with great cinematography and some impressive action sequences. While I don't think the third season is quite as good as the previous two, overall Mexico is brilliant. narcos-mexico-poster.jpeg Narcos: Mexico Drama Release Date 2018 - 2021-00-00 Where to watch Close WHERE TO WATCH Streaming Network Netflix Cast Diego Luna, Michael Pena Showrunner Carlo Bernard Genres Drama Seasons 3 Streaming Service(s) Netflix Powered by Expand Collapse 2 The Walking Dead: Dead City Regular readers of this column will know that I'm a mega Walking Dead fan . Anything the franchise produces, I lap up. Despite that, I'm not blindly faithful. I acknowledge the main TV show had its wobbles, and spin-offs like World Beyond and Fear the Walking Dead stumbled into disastrous territory. With that in mind, I'm happy to recommend The Walking Dead: Dead City . This is set after the events of the now-finished The Walking Dead , with fan-favorite characters Negan (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Maggie (Lauren Cohan) facing new threats in Manhattan. Those two have a lot of baggage that carries over, but I don't think you need to be a series veteran to appreciate Dead City . Negan and Maggie travel to the zombie-infested island to rescue Maggie's son, Hershel (Logan Kim), who has been kidnapped by a cruel gang leader called The Croat (Željko Ivanek). Well, make that "15th anniversary," to be more precise. With that in mind, series director, effects master, and executive producer Greg Nicotero took to social media to honor the occasion with a flashback to where it all began. "Happy 15th Anniversary! Yes it has been 15 years since THE WALKING DEAD premiered on AMC…and the rest as they say is history! Congratulations to all who have had a hand in making the show…from assistant directors and props to make up effects and editorial!" Nicotero wrote as the caption to his Instagram post, sharing a behind-the-scenes look at himself and Andrew Lincoln (Rick Grimes, like we needed to tell you) from the first episode. Lincoln Teases "Conversation" We've got Norman Reedus and Melissa McBride -starring The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon in production on a fourth season. Meanwhile, Lauren Cohan and Jeffrey Dean Morgan -starring The Walking Dead: Dead City is filming its third season. But what about beyond that? Could we see a second season of Lincoln and Danai Gurira -starring The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live ? Could we finally see a series that gets the band back together for some kind of epic showdown? Lincoln dropped a big clue back in September during a conversation with BBC One's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg . During an interview in support of his live-theater run in The Lady From the Sea , Lincoln shared what his experience was like, personally and professionally, during his time with the series. When asked if he would consider returning as Rick Grimes to the TWD Universe, Lincoln responded, "There's a conversation happening right now," before shifting the focus back onto the play. Reedus shared a post commemorating the end of his run as Daryl Dixon, during the final day of filming The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon Season 4 . “Last filming day today for daryl dixon,” Reedus wrote. “It’s been such a joy for me to play this guy with all of u for this long. I feel really blessed. Truly. Thank you all really from my heart”. Videos by ComicBook.com The post came with an ominous teaser photo of Daryl’s face in profile, looking very weathered, gritty, and pensive. It was a nice arthouse-style teaser image for the final part of Daryl Dixon’s story, and perfectly captured the spirit of Norman Reedus in a single image. Norman Reedus / X The Daryl Dixon series has seen the titular character on a European tour, where he eventually linked up with his bestie Carol (Melissa McBride). SPOILERS: Season 3 saw Daryl and Carol take down an authoritative regime in Spain, run by the surviving remnants of the monarchy. However, when the group tried to set sail back home, the local “mayor,” Fede, ambushed them, and the boat was destroyed, leaving Daryl and Carol stranded. Season 4 of Daryl Dixon will likely be about the hard journey home, and no one is guaranteed to actually make it, including Daryl himself. Reedus has been playing this character (invented for the show) since The Walking Dead started in 2010, so getting off the train now would be acceptable. That doesn’t mean that fans are ready to accept it, though. Walking Dead Fans Don’t Believe It’s The End For Daryl Dixon AMC Fan reactions to Norman Reedus’ retirement post for Daryl Dixon clearly prove that they are not buying it as the definitive end for the character. “Am i the only one that read this as its the last day for the SERIES and not character?” writes @onterrorstreet . “Hes thanking everyone for playing the character this long and thats it haha… Rick and Daryl reunion next lets hope!” Read Next 10 Plot Twists That Changed The Walking Dead Forever @Clarebear230 490 wasn’t even pretending to be objective, posting, “Nah I’m in denial. We HAVE to have a Rick and Daryl hug one last time!” @Vinod_r108 , on the other hand, is choosing to keep a positive POV, posting “I hope it’s just a “see you soon.” And we can still see the reunion that the actors, characters, and fans deserve.” And @wrestleroller has very measured hopes: “Hoping we see you and Andrew 1 more time as your characters”. There’s always the possibility of the original (and surviving) Walking Dead characters all being reunited for some kind of event film or series. The main stars (Andrew Lincoln, Danai Gurira, Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Lauren Cohan, etc.) have branched out into spinoffs like Fear the Walking Dead, Dead City, and The Ones Who Live – separate paths through the Walking Dead universe that can still converge again. All the cast members, showrunners, and franchise producers have mastered the art of keeping possibilities alive in interviews, without ever committing to anything real. So… maybe it won’t be the end of Daryl Dixon, after all. The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon airs on AMC. News By MarkJulian - Nov 22, 2025 12:11 PM EST Filed Under: Netflix Source: Toonado.com Zack Snyder’s Twilight of the Gods wraps its first season on a major cliffhanger, but it appears Netflix has no plans to continue the story. According to a new report, the series has been cancelled, alongside Exploding Kittens and the animated reboot of Good Times . ‘Twilight of the Gods’, ‘Exploding Kittens’ and ‘Good Times’ have all been canceled after one season at Netflix. (Source: https://t.co/p9NJm21Xcg ) pic.twitter.com/fnUKiBUhQX — Cartoon Base (@TheCartoonBase) November 21, 2025 Season 1 of Twilight of the Gods ends with the revelation that Loki was secretly the mastermind behind the events that sent Sigrid on her quest of vengeance and with the death of Baldr triggering the beginning events of Ragnarök, it certainly seemed as if the stage was set for more episodes. However, according to What's On Netflix , the streamer has decided not to produce additional episodes of Snyder's animation project and the decision was based purely on viewership ratings. The show ultimately didn’t perform at the level Netflix had hoped on a global scale, an issue it shares with several other high-profile Snyder-led projects at the service. Snyder's other projects at the network, additional installments in the Army of the Dead and Rebel Moon universes, also appear to be dead in the water. His previously announced LAPD action thriller is also said to now be placed on the streamer's back burner. Circling back to Twilight of the Gods, the 8-episode project was a collaboration between Snyder's Stone Quarry Animation and the France-based Xilam Animation, with Jay Oliva serving as showrunner and Eric Carrasco positioned as head writer. Previously, Snyder said he and Oliva were keenly interested in making a second season, stating, "Yes, there’s a massive roadmap. We know exactly what will happen. It’s just a matter of seeing if there’s an appetite for it." But it doesn't look as if that's going to come to fruition, at least at Netflix. The full voice cast for Twilight of the Gods featured: Sylvia Hoeks (Blade Runner 2049) as SIGRID Stuart Martin (Army of Thieves) as LEIF Pilou Asbæk (Game of Thrones, Ghost in the Shell) as THOR John Noble (Lord of the Rings, Fringe) as ODIN Paterson Joseph (Timeless) as LOKI Rahul Kohli (Supergirl, iZombie) as EGILL Jamie Clayton (Sense8) as THE SEID-KONA Kristopher Hivju (Game of Thrones) as ANDVARI Peter Stormare (American Gods, Castlevania) as ULFR Jamie Chung (Sucker Punch, Lovecraft Country) as HEL Lauren Cohan (The Walking Dead) as INGE Corey Stoll (Ant-Man, The Strain) as HRAFNKEL In a mythical world of great battles, great deeds, and great despair, Leif (Stuart Martin), a mortal king, is saved on the battlefield by Sigrid (Sylvia Hoeks), an iron-willed warrior with whom he falls in love. On their wedding night, Sigrid and Leif survive a wrath of terror from Thor (Pilou Asbæk), which sets them — and a crew of crusaders — on a merciless mission for vengeance, against all odds. This heroic story of love, loss, and revenge, is a journey to hell and beyond … across fantastical lands, battlefields fierce and bloody, and wars waged against deities and demons. Nowadays, it feels like most shows on basic television and streaming services are either whodunnits, grisly crime thrillers, or "eat the rich" satires . With A Murder at the End of the World , you get all three rolled into one. Despite receiving positive reviews upon release on FX/Hulu in 2023, the seven-episode miniseries, created by the duo of Brit Marling and Zal Batmanglij , seems to have been lost to time. With the cold weather upon us, there is no better time to catch up on this intense psychological thriller set on an isolated Arctic retreat in Iceland. Starring Emma Corrin , Harris Dickinson , Joan Chen , and Clive Owen , A Murder at the End of the World will keep you spooked and guessing. 'The OA' Meets a Police Procedural in FX's 'A Murder at the End of the World' Emma Corrin in the Murder at the End of the World finale Image via FX Brit Marling and Zal Batmanglij proved themselves to be a dynamic creative pair as co-creators of The OA , the two-season Netflix mystery drama starring Marling as the central character. Marling also starred and co-wrote the 2013 film, The East , a psychological drama directed by Batmanglij. The two clearly have chemistry, and their creative partnership culminated in their most enduring and fascinating work to date, A Murder at the End of the World , which ran from November 14 to December 19 in 2023. The series follows Darby Hart (Corrin), an amateur detective, and 8 other guests invited to a retreat at the secluded home of reclusive billionaire Andy Ronson (Owen), who was interested in Darby's publications as an independent sleuth. When one of the guests, Darby's former partner, Bill (Dickinson), is found dead, she must step up and become a sleuth on the spot to uncover the truth behind this bizarre mystery . The concept of strangers convening at a mysterious house only to encounter a murder with a perpetrator hiding in plain sight is nothing new, going all the way back to Agatha Christie novels and Clue , and most recently seen in Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery and Blink Twice . Amid contemporary economic distress and class alienation in everyday life, scathing critiques of the wealthy upper class have remained fresh in film and television, even if they have developed shorthand clichés. The FX/Hulu series expands upon the eerie depiction of the privileged class by also tackling other pressing societal anxieties , notably the dread of artificial intelligence and the general distortion of reality and fiction. Ronson, a tech tycoon sharing many traits with some of our most influential business leaders today, pretends to be an ally of Gen-Z dialogue and concerns, but the divide between him and Darby couldn't be further. 'A Murder at the End of the World' Is a Sharp Murder Mystery Perfect for Gen Z Darby's status as a detective of Generation Z is the backbone of A Murder at the End of the World , as her trepidatious disposition and skepticism toward trusted institutions are emblematic of the disaffected nature of America's future. Being raised by a single father, as her mother left when she was a child, Darby had naturally been drawn to the dark underbelly of the world, and she spent most of her time browsing Reddit and its eerie wormholes. As a detective in a position of power to solve a cryptic mystery, Darby empowers the cynical worldview of the generation by channeling it into something impactful. This sincere dissection of values, characterized by Darby's determination to solve assault cases against women, often supplants the plot development of the murder mystery, but Marling and Batmanglij were far more intrigued by the mindset of a young detective. The series delivers as a procedural drama , filled with many gripping sequences of old-school detective work with a glossy technological spin and a provocative twist ending , so its commentary never hinders the viewing experience. If anything, the show is grounded compared to Marling and Batmanglij's abstract tendencies seen in The OA . Emma Corrin and Harris Dickinson Raise the Dramatic Stakes of 'A Murder at the End of the World' Emma Corrin and Harris Dickinson in A Murder at the End of the World Image via FX Although Harris Dickinson, one of Hollywood's brightest stars, who is tapped to play John Lennon in Sam Mendes ' four-part Beatles biopic, is written out of the main narrative early, we see him interact with The Crown 's Emma Corrin via flashbacks. Set six years prior to the events in the series, the flashbacks follow Darby and Bill as they uncover the remains of a victim of a suspected serial killer in the basement. While Darby is intoxicated by the case, even getting her father, a coroner, involved, Bill is cautious of her intrepid sleuthing, as he is grappling with the psychological ramifications of witnessing such carnage. As compelling as the present-day murder mystery is, A Murder at the End of the World is at its most dramatically immersive during these flashbacks , which underlines Darby's obsessive desires as a detective and the alienating effects these tendencies have on those surrounding her. Related Timothy Olyphant’s FX Neo-Western Had To Rewrite Its Biggest Mistake in the Pilot After Viewer Backlash Talk about dodging a bullet. Posts By Jessica Toomer Oct 26, 2025 From the get-go, thanks to the chilly, moody atmosphere, exceptionally deployed by the visual team, audiences suspect something is afoot in A Murder at the End of the World , and this overriding sense of dread hangs over the entire narrative. Fear lingers throughout each episode — fear of the future and the sinister truth of the murder mystery. "I didn’t know how to give up or how to sense danger when danger was closing in," Darby says to the audience, reflecting the toxic nature of her obsessive proclivities and egoism as a savior on the Internet. This concept comes alive in the various flashbacks between Darby and Bill, a running narrative that could've served as its own stirring drama. Brit Marling and Zal Batmanglij's series is worth the investment just for the performances by Emma Corrin and Harris Dickinson alone, two young British actors with impeccable chemistry whose unique screen presences continue to resonate with the public. a-murder-at-the-end-of-the-world-poster.jpg 9 10 A Murder at the End of the World Like Follow Followed Drama Mystery Thriller Release Date 2023 - 2023-00-00 Network FX Showrunner Zal Batmanglij , Brit Marling Directors Zal Batmanglij , Brit Marling Writers Zal Batmanglij , Brit Marling , Cherie Dimaline, Rebecca Roanhorse, Melanie Marnich Cast See All Emma Corrin Clive Owen Where to watch Close WHERE TO WATCH Streaming Genres Drama , Mystery, Thriller Creator(s) Zal Batmanglij , Brit Marling Powered by Expand Collapse Google is updating how content is shown. When one of the guests, Darby's former partner, Bill (Dickinson), is found dead, she must step up and become a sleuth on the spot to uncover the truth behind this bizarre mystery. The concept of strangers convening at a mysterious house only to encounter a murder with a perpetrator hiding in plain sight is nothing new, going all the way back to Agatha Christie novels and Clue , and most recently seen in Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery and Blink Twice. Amid contemporary economic distress and class alienation in everyday life, scathing critiques of the wealthy upper class have remained fresh in film and television, even if they have developed shorthand clichés. The FX/Hulu series expands upon the eerie depiction of the privileged class by also tackling other pressing societal anxieties , notably the dread of artificial intelligence and the general distortion of reality and fiction. Ronson, a tech tycoon sharing many traits with some of our most influential business leaders today, pretends to be an ally of Gen-Z dialogue and concerns, but the divide between him and Darby couldn't be further. 'A Murder at the End of the World' Is a Sharp Murder Mystery Perfect for Gen Z Darby's status as a detective of Generation Z is the backbone of A Murder at the End of the World , as her trepidatious disposition and skepticism toward trusted institutions are emblematic of the disaffected nature of America's future. Being raised by a single father, as her mother left when she was a child, Darby had naturally been drawn to the dark underbelly of the world, and she spent most of her time browsing Reddit and its eerie wormholes. As a detective in a position of power to solve a cryptic mystery, Darby empowers the cynical worldview of the generation by channeling it into something impactful. This sincere dissection of values, characterized by Darby's determination to solve assault cases against women, often supplants the plot development of the murder mystery, but Marling and Batmanglij were far more intrigued by the mindset of a young detective. The series delivers as a procedural drama , filled with many gripping sequences of old-school detective work with a glossy technological spin and a provocative twist ending , so its commentary never hinders the viewing experience. If anything, the show is grounded compared to Marling and Batmanglij's abstract tendencies seen in The OA. Emma Corrin and Harris Dickinson Raise the Dramatic Stakes of 'A Murder at the End of the World' Emma Corrin and Harris Dickinson in A Murder at the End of the World Image via FX Although Harris Dickinson, one of Hollywood's brightest stars, who is tapped to play John Lennon in Sam Mendes ' four-part Beatles biopic, is written out of the main narrative early, we see him interact with The Crown 's Emma Corrin via flashbacks. Set six years prior to the events in the series, the flashbacks follow Darby and Bill as they uncover the remains of a victim of a suspected serial killer in the basement. While Darby is intoxicated by the case, even getting her father, a coroner, involved, Bill is cautious of her intrepid sleuthing, as he is grappling with the psychological ramifications of witnessing such carnage. As compelling as the present-day murder mystery is, A Murder at the End of the World is at its most dramatically immersive during these flashbacks , which underlines Darby's obsessive desires as a detective and the alienating effects these tendencies have on those surrounding her. Posts By Jessica Toomer Oct 26, 2025 From the get-go, thanks to the chilly, moody atmosphere, exceptionally deployed by the visual team, audiences suspect something is afoot in A Murder at the End of the World , and this overriding sense of dread hangs over the entire narrative. Fear lingers throughout each episode — fear of the future and the sinister truth of the murder mystery. "I didn’t know how to give up or how to sense danger when danger was closing in," Darby says to the audience, reflecting the toxic nature of her obsessive proclivities and egoism as a savior on the Internet. This concept comes alive in the various flashbacks between Darby and Bill, a running narrative that could've served as its own stirring drama. text: James singer Tim Booth: ‘I had a near-death experience when I was 21’ , The Times Today's Quizle Q: Test your knowledge My favourite author or book David Mitchell’s Cloud Atlas . It’s mind-boggling, the way he jumps into different genres and characters. The first 60 pages are fairly impenetrable and then it jumps time and becomes coherent. The structure mirrors the point of the book: eternal recurrence echoing reincarnation. He’s made at least two or three masterpieces. I could also have said Doris Lessing or Cormac McCarthy. The book I’m reading Whitney Webb’s One Nation Under Blackmail . She’s a journalist with an almost photographic memory, outlining the connection between the CIA and the mafia — leading us up to Epstein, showing that paedophile honeytraps have been a mainstay of American politics and power mongering since the Second World War. The book I wish I had written Blood Meridian by Cormac McCarthy. It’s remarkable: a sentence might go on for a page and a half. It was before his writing got very terse, almost like Hemingway. This is massively flamboyantly written. I’d call it a hallucinogenic western. It’s so rich, like having a meal at the Fat Duck. The book I couldn’t finish Ulysses . Some chapters are really quite digestible. Then you hit chapters that are so written in the moment — it takes a lot of patience. • Read more book reviews and interviews — and see what’s top of the Sunday Times Bestsellers List Advertisement The book I’m ashamed I haven’t read Moby-Dick . I’ve got through about three quarters of it and enjoyed it, but never somehow seemed to finish it. It just didn’t hold me enough to keep going. My favourite film Casablanca . It shouldn’t be that good: the production was chaos, it was motivated as a propaganda tool to get America involved in the Second World War, they were still writing the final scene right up until filming it, the actors all hated it and thought they were in a flop and it’s ended up one of the greatest movies ever made. And the music is incredible. Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman in Casablanca (1942) GETTY IMAGES My favourite play Strange Fish by DV8, a physical theatre company. I saw it in 1992 and then saw nearly everything they did for the next 20 years — all shockingly watchable, funny and profound. I remember this opened with a naked woman on a cross being crucified while singing an incredible piece of music by Jocelyn Pook in what sounded like a backwards language. The TV series that I’m watching Gen V on Prime Video, a spinoff from The Boys but better. It’s about how intoxicated superheroes would become with their own power and what assholes they would probably be. It’s fascinating. And there are lots of cocks in it, redressing the balance. My favourite TV series The OA on Netflix. It felt like the writers were channelling a show just for me. I’ve spent three years dancing and teaching people how to move into altered states through dancing and breathing and I had a near-death experience — I almost died when I was 21 because of a liver disease — so I related to it in a really personal way. Advertisement Brit Marling in The OA OLIVIA BEE/NETFLIX My favourite piece of music Too many to mention. I could say Nina Simone’s I Wish I Knew How It Would Feel to Be Free . But I’m going to say Jocelyn Pook’s Upon This Rock from the DV8 piece. We play it before going on stage and it will be played at my funeral. It’s a fusion of east and west, starting with an incredible ululation and then going into classical choir music. • Read more music reviews, interviews and guides on what to listen to next The last TV programme that made me laugh The stand-up comedian Mike Birbiglia’s The Old Man and the Pool . It’s so articulate, gentle, clever and performed with such vulnerability. The lyric I wish I’d written “You told me again you preferred handsome men / But for me you would make an exception” from Leonard Cohen’s Chelsea Hotel No. 2 . This song is the greatest encapsulation of a fleeting relationship ever written. It’s Leonard Cohen having sex with Janis Joplin while the limousines wait in the street. I think he had an affair with most people. The song that saved me Patti Smith’s Birdland , a song about a boy losing his father which I heard on the night I was told, aged 16, my father was going to die. He was having an operation and they didn’t think he’d survive, but he did. This piece opened me up to the power of song as medicine. Advertisement Patti Smith performing in New York in 1975 CHARLIE STEINER/GETTY IMAGES The instrument I play My body. The instrument I wish I’d learnt Keyboard because you’d have access to every other instrument. But going off passion it would be accordion or banjo. The music that cheers me up Any genre cheers me up if it’s genius because it cheers me up to know there is genius in the world. At the moment it might be Cameron Winter’s song Love Takes Miles . He’s wonderful. If I could own one painting it would be Van Gogh’s Bedroom in Arles or Starry Night . Everything is alive — no one else’s art quite captures that in the same way. Van Gogh’s Bedroom in Arles, 1889 VCG WILSON/CORBIS/GETTY IMAGES The place I feel happiest Big Sur, California, where the mountains meet the sea. You might see whales and dolphins and sea otters. It’s nature as God intended before humans came along and ruined it. Advertisement My guiltiest cultural pleasure Buffy the Vampire Slayer . I’ve watched all 145 episodes twice with both of my sons over different time periods. I loved every minute. I’m having a fantasy dinner party. I’ll invite these artists and authors Brian Eno, Albert Einstein, Jennifer Lawrence, Niki de Saint Phalle, Van Gogh, Mark Twain, David Mitchell, Greta Thunberg, Robin Williams. And I’ll put on this music A mixture of circus and melancholic music. The movie that I’m looking forward to Bugonia . Emma Stone in Yorgos Lanthimos’s Bugonia (2025) ATSUSHI NISHIJIMA/FOCUS FEATURES/ALAMY I wasted an evening watching Instagram conspiracy theories and dog videos. Advertisement The film I walked out of The English Patient . Most people enjoyed it — I thought it was appalling. • Read more film reviews, guides about what to watch and interviews Overrated Musicians who are cultural icons rather than artists and have a career based on one album or one song. Capitalism plus art is a car crash. To find real art you have to wade through a lot of shit. Underrated DV8. And Mary Margaret O’Hara, the singer who can’t really perform because she’s too vulnerable. Apparently she has hundreds of songs she just can’t get out to the public. Ronnie Burkett’s theatre of marionettes — he’s a puppet master from Montreal and his pieces take two years to create. It’s like watching American Beauty acted by puppets. Now, following the huge success of both events, we are back with the biggest preview event yet this winter. From a brand-new look at the likes of Wicked: For Good , The SpongeBob Movie: Search For SquarePants , and Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 , to exclusive clips from some of the most exciting new movies and shows across the world, this winter preview week has been Collider's biggest yet. With exclusives from nearly 99 titles in just six days, there has been plenty to keep up with. To make sure you haven't missed a beat, here's a full round-up of this most impressive preview event yet in this recap of every exclusive we debuted this week. 'In Your Dreams' Now streaming on Netflix For those looking for a viewing option that caters to the whole family, In Your Dreams is a go-to. The Netflix animation, directed by Alex Woo and Erik Benson, follows Stevie ( Jolie Hoang‑Rappaport ) and her brother Elliot ( Elias Janssen ), as they grapple with their parents' recent divorce. In the hopes of saving their parent's marriage, the siblings resort to the world of dreams to find The Sandman, a mysterious figure who has the power to grant wishes. Our sneak peek of the film shows Stevie and Elliot on an adventurous ride, as they fly through the clouds while hanging on to the bed frame as if their lives depended on it. Get all the details about In Your Dreams in our exclusive preview . 'Tinsel Town' Release Date: November 28, 2025 kiefer-sutherland-in-tinsel-town Image via Brainstorm Media Christmas is right around the corner, and with it comes an array of holiday titles, including this one. In Tinsel Town , Kiefer Sutherland plays Bradley Mack, a washed-up action star who heads to an English village after securing a role in an idiosyncratic Christmas pageant. While there, he not only bonds with a strong-willed choreographer ( Rebel Wilson ), but sees an opportunity to repair his relationship with his daughter. Our exclusive look at the holiday film shows Bradley on stage holding a massive snowman in one hand and a mic in the other, likely entertaining audiences with his performance. Get all the details about Tinsel Town in our exclusive preview . 'Playdate' Now streaming on Prime Video Kevin James and Alan Ritchson plan a playdate in Prime Video's latest offering. The action comedy follows Brian (James) and Jeff (Ritchson), two parents who decide to spend an easy-going afternoon with their sons, tossing footballs and engaging in small talk. Yet, they are instead thrust into a chaotic scramble to stay alive, as ruthless mercenaries hunt them down. While Brian has no physical strength for battle, Jeff is oddly prepared to face the criminals head on. In the clip above, the main characters are being chased by Brian's ex-girlfriend, Leslie ( Isla Fisher ), and her friends. From the likes of it, Leslie is thirsty for revenge, and won't back down until she gets what she wants. Get all the details about Playdate in our exclusive preview. 'Now You See Me: Now You Don't' Release Date: In Theaters Now Right now, global theaters have been sprinkled with magic as the hotly anticipated Now You See Me: Now You Don’t begins its box office run. Earlier this week, as part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted four exclusive images from the threequel, available to view above. Jesse Eisenberg , Woody Harrelson , Dave Franco , and Isla Fisher all reprise their roles as the original Horsemen, joined by a new batch of budding magicians, played by Justice Smith , Dominic Sessa, and Ariana Greenblatt . Directed by Ruben Fleischer , the movie promises plenty of twists and turns as the Horsemen face their most ambitious adventure yet. Get all the details about Now You See Me: Now You Don't in our exclusive look . 'A Merry Little Ex-Mas' Release Date: On Netflix Now Alicia Silverstone in Merry Little Ex-Mas Christmas came early in Collider's Winter Preview Event, with a brand-new image of Netflix's latest holiday-themed rom-com, A Merry Little Ex-Mas . Starring Alicia Silverstone , fresh off her role in Yorgos Lanthimos 's latest movie, Bugonia , and Oliver Hudson as exes getting together for one final family celebration before they split up forever, the movie promises to usher in the festive season on the world's biggest streamer. Directed by Steve Carr and penned by Holly Hester , the film is the latest in a long line of similar Netflix Christmas movies, with the platform continuing its bid to be known as the go-to festive streamer. Get all the details about A Merry Little Ex-Mas in our exclusive look . 'Bat-Fam' Now Streaming on Prime Video Image via Prime Video A new Batman animated series has arrived on streaming, and it functions as a spin-off to the 2023 hit holiday film, Merry Little Batman . Bat-Fam is centered on Bruce Wayne ( Luke Wilson ), Damian Wayne ( Yonas Kibreab ), and Alfred Pennyworth ( James Cromwell ), as they welcome three new residents to Wayne Manor. The series will explore how this family of misfits (pictured in the image above) navigate the fun and chaos of Gotham City, as they work together to protect civilians from luring threats. Balancing both comedy and action, this animation, developed by Mike Roth & Jase Ricci , will surely fill the DC superhero void since the releases of Superman and Peacemaker Season 2. Get all the details about Bat-Fam in our exclusive preview. 'Champagne Problems' Release Date: November 19, 2025 minka-kelly-champagne-problems-netflix Directed and written by Mark Steven Johnson , Champagne Problems is set to be your next rom-com obsession as it makes its debut on November 19. Starring Ransom Canyon favorite Minka Kelly as a huge moment in her professional career is interrupted by the arrival of Slow Horses alum Tom Wozniczka , with an unlikely romance blossoming. As part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted an exclusive image of the pair getting cozy and surrounded by the magic of Christmas as love begins to simmer. Alongside Kelly and Wozniczka, the movie also stars All Quiet on the Western Front 's Thibault de Montalemert , Sean Amsing, Flula Borg, Astrid Whettnall, Xavier Samuel, Mitchell Mullen , and Maeve Courtier-Lilley . Get all the details about Champagne Problems in our exclusive look . 'Jingle Bell Heist' Release Date: November 26, 2025 jingle-bell-heist-netflix If you're a fan of Christmas movies but want something with a bit of an edge, Netflix has you covered as Jingle Bell Heist debuts later this month on November 26. Blending the heart of holiday-themed rom-coms with heist movie thrills , Jingle Bell Heist follows Olivia Holt and Connor Swindells as two people down on their luck who seek to take their small-time thieving to new heights as they plan to steal from London's most notorious department store. As part of Collider's winter Preview Event, we debuted an image of Holt and Swindells dressed in the finery of expert con artists. The movie is directed by Michael Fimognari , best known for helming the two sequels to the hit teen flick To All the Boys I've Loved Before . Directed by Mike Rohl of The Princess Switch fame and penned by the duo of Carley Smale and Ron Oliver , My Secret Santa also stars Alexandra Breckenridge , Madison MacIsaac, and Diana Maria Riva. Get all the details about Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery in our exclusive look . The first installment amassed 103 million views in 2021, becoming one of the most popular non-English titles on the platform. Troll 2 will see a new creature unleashing devastation across Norway, leading paleontology professor Nora Tidemann ( Ine Marie Wilmann ) and her colleagues to face their most perilous mission yet. Collider gives you a first look at a scene from the film, showing the troll destroying everything in his wake. Get all the details about Troll 2 in our exclusive preview . 'Scrubs' Release Date: February 25, 2026 The cast of Scrubs gathered for a table read for the reboot Image via ABC J.D. ( Zach Braff ), Turk ( Donald Faison ), and the gang will return to their shifts 16 years after Scrubs aired its final episode. Get all the details about Scrubs in our exclusive preview . 'Sidelined 2: Intercepted' Release Date: November 27, 2025 After the success of Sidelined: The QB and Me , fans of the Wattpad adaptation couldn't be more excited about seeing Drayton ( Noah Beck ) and Dallas ( Siena Agudong ) together again. The exclusive images above show Drayton and Dallas in their respective elements, as well as introduce a new character (played by Charlie Gillespie ) that might get in the way of their bond. Get all the details about Sidelined 2: Intercepted in our exclusive preview . 'Oh. What. Every year, Claire is the queen of Christmas, putting together the perfect itinerary for her family's festive fun. However, on one fateful year, the clan accidentally leaves her home alone and feeling underappreciated, sending Claire on an unlikely adventure to find the true meaning of Christmas. Fun in our exclusive look . Tony Kiritsis ( Bill Skarsgård ) takes Richard Hall ( Dacre Montgomery ) hostage, but instead of being condoned for it, he becomes an outlaw hero. Collider is pleased to share new images and an exclusive interview with screenwriter Austin Kolodney about the story's origins and why he felt like Van Sant was the perfect fit to make this film. Get all the details about Dead Man's Wire in our exclusive preview . 'Ella McCay' Release Date: December 12, 2025 ella-mccay-emma-mackey Emma Mackey and Jamie Lee Curtis will collaborate on Academy Award-winner James L. Brooks ' anticipated comedy, Ella McCay . The film is centered on the titular character, as she balances work and family. It's being described as "a story about the people you love and how to survive them." According to Brooks, it pays homage to comedies from the '40s and '50s, capturing the zany sense of humor of the era while also taking into account the pains and pitfalls of being a human. The image above gives us a glimpse at Ella and her idealistic personality. The film's cast also includes Ayo Edebiri , Woody Harrelson , and Kumail Nanjian . Get all the details about Ella McCay in our exclusive preview . 'Eternity' Release Date: November 26, 2025 ETERNITY-MILES-TELLER-ELIZABETH-OLSEN For those missing genuinely good rom-coms, A24's latest offering will sweep you off your feet. It follows Larry ( Miles Teller ) and Joan ( Elizabeth Olsen ), an elderly couple who die one week apart from each other. They reunite in the afterlife, where they must pick a destination to spend eternity at. From the image above, you can already tell what Larry and Joan's future could look like if they were to choose a never-ending beach day. Yet, their sunny destination might be on the line when Joan faces a personal dilemma. She must decide on whether to spend eternity with the man she grew old with, or with her first husband ( Callum Turner ), who died in the war and has been waiting for forever to reunite with her in the afterlife. Get all the details about Eternity in our exclusive preview . Greenland 2: Migration is set to be just as successful, following the aftermath of the comet strike, as the Garrity family (pictured above) leaves their bunker in Greenland in search of a new home. Videos 2025 Movie Releases Screenings What to Watch Originals Reviews Close Collider's Winter Preview Unveils Exclusive Casting News, Images, and Sneak Peeks From 99 Must-Watch Movies and Series Image via Jefferson Chacon By Jake Hodges & Isabella Soares Published Nov 16, 2025 Sign in to your Collider account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread 4 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap After a sizzling selection of the summer's best exclusives , Collider returned with a bigger and better preview week this fall. Now, following the huge success of both events, we are back with the biggest preview event yet this winter. From a brand-new look at the likes of Wicked: For Good , The SpongeBob Movie: Search For SquarePants , and Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 , to exclusive clips from some of the most exciting new movies and shows across the world, this winter preview week has been Collider's biggest yet. With exclusives from nearly 99 titles in just six days, there has been plenty to keep up with. To make sure you haven't missed a beat, here's a full round-up of this most impressive preview event yet in this recap of every exclusive we debuted this week. 'In Your Dreams' Now streaming on Netflix For those looking for a viewing option that caters to the whole family, In Your Dreams is a go-to. The Netflix animation, directed by Alex Woo and Erik Benson, follows Stevie ( Jolie Hoang‑Rappaport ) and her brother Elliot ( Elias Janssen ), as they grapple with their parents' recent divorce. In the hopes of saving their parent's marriage, the siblings resort to the world of dreams to find The Sandman, a mysterious figure who has the power to grant wishes. Our sneak peek of the film shows Stevie and Elliot on an adventurous ride, as they fly through the clouds while hanging on to the bed frame as if their lives depended on it. Get all the details about In Your Dreams in our exclusive preview. 'Tinsel Town' Release Date: November 28, 2025 kiefer-sutherland-in-tinsel-town Image via Brainstorm Media Christmas is right around the corner, and with it comes an array of holiday titles, including this one. In Tinsel Town , Kiefer Sutherland plays Bradley Mack, a washed-up action star who heads to an English village after securing a role in an idiosyncratic Christmas pageant. While there, he not only bonds with a strong-willed choreographer ( Rebel Wilson ), but sees an opportunity to repair his relationship with his daughter. Our exclusive look at the holiday film shows Bradley on stage holding a massive snowman in one hand and a mic in the other, likely entertaining audiences with his performance. Get all the details about Tinsel Town in our exclusive preview. 'Playdate' Now streaming on Prime Video Kevin James and Alan Ritchson plan a playdate in Prime Video's latest offering. The action comedy follows Brian (James) and Jeff (Ritchson), two parents who decide to spend an easy-going afternoon with their sons, tossing footballs and engaging in small talk. Yet, they are instead thrust into a chaotic scramble to stay alive, as ruthless mercenaries hunt them down. While Brian has no physical strength for battle, Jeff is oddly prepared to face the criminals head on. In the clip above, the main characters are being chased by Brian's ex-girlfriend, Leslie ( Isla Fisher ), and her friends. From the likes of it, Leslie is thirsty for revenge, and won't back down until she gets what she wants. Get all the details about Playdate in our exclusive preview. 'Now You See Me: Now You Don't' Release Date: In Theaters Now Right now, global theaters have been sprinkled with magic as the hotly anticipated Now You See Me: Now You Don’t begins its box office run. Earlier this week, as part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted four exclusive images from the threequel, available to view above. Jesse Eisenberg , Woody Harrelson , Dave Franco , and Isla Fisher all reprise their roles as the original Horsemen, joined by a new batch of budding magicians, played by Justice Smith , Dominic Sessa, and Ariana Greenblatt. Directed by Ruben Fleischer , the movie promises plenty of twists and turns as the Horsemen face their most ambitious adventure yet. Get all the details about Now You See Me: Now You Don't in our exclusive look. 'A Merry Little Ex-Mas' Release Date: On Netflix Now Alicia Silverstone in Merry Little Ex-Mas Christmas came early in Collider's Winter Preview Event, with a brand-new image of Netflix's latest holiday-themed rom-com, A Merry Little Ex-Mas. Starring Alicia Silverstone , fresh off her role in Yorgos Lanthimos 's latest movie, Bugonia , and Oliver Hudson as exes getting together for one final family celebration before they split up forever, the movie promises to usher in the festive season on the world's biggest streamer. Directed by Steve Carr and penned by Holly Hester , the film is the latest in a long line of similar Netflix Christmas movies, with the platform continuing its bid to be known as the go-to festive streamer. Get all the details about A Merry Little Ex-Mas in our exclusive look. 'Bat-Fam' Now Streaming on Prime Video Image via Prime Video A new Batman animated series has arrived on streaming, and it functions as a spin-off to the 2023 hit holiday film, Merry Little Batman. Bat-Fam is centered on Bruce Wayne ( Luke Wilson ), Damian Wayne ( Yonas Kibreab ), and Alfred Pennyworth ( James Cromwell ), as they welcome three new residents to Wayne Manor. The series will explore how this family of misfits (pictured in the image above) navigate the fun and chaos of Gotham City, as they work together to protect civilians from luring threats. Balancing both comedy and action, this animation, developed by Mike Roth & Jase Ricci , will surely fill the DC superhero void since the releases of Superman and Peacemaker Season 2. Get all the details about Bat-Fam in our exclusive preview. 'Champagne Problems' Release Date: November 19, 2025 minka-kelly-champagne-problems-netflix Directed and written by Mark Steven Johnson , Champagne Problems is set to be your next rom-com obsession as it makes its debut on November 19. Starring Ransom Canyon favorite Minka Kelly as a huge moment in her professional career is interrupted by the arrival of Slow Horses alum Tom Wozniczka , with an unlikely romance blossoming. As part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted an exclusive image of the pair getting cozy and surrounded by the magic of Christmas as love begins to simmer. Alongside Kelly and Wozniczka, the movie also stars All Quiet on the Western Front 's Thibault de Montalemert , Sean Amsing, Flula Borg, Astrid Whettnall, Xavier Samuel, Mitchell Mullen , and Maeve Courtier-Lilley. Get all the details about Champagne Problems in our exclusive look. 'Jingle Bell Heist' Release Date: November 26, 2025 jingle-bell-heist-netflix If you're a fan of Christmas movies but want something with a bit of an edge, Netflix has you covered as Jingle Bell Heist debuts later this month on November 26. Blending the heart of holiday-themed rom-coms with heist movie thrills , Jingle Bell Heist follows Olivia Holt and Connor Swindells as two people down on their luck who seek to take their small-time thieving to new heights as they plan to steal from London's most notorious department store. As part of Collider's winter Preview Event, we debuted an image of Holt and Swindells dressed in the finery of expert con artists. The movie is directed by Michael Fimognari , best known for helming the two sequels to the hit teen flick To All the Boys I've Loved Before. Get all the details about Jingle Bell Heist in our exclusive look. ‘My Secret Santa’ Release Date: December 3, 2025 my-secret-santa-netflix The Christmas exclusives just kept on coming in Collider’s Winter Preview Event, as we teamed up with Netflix to bring a brand-new look at another of their stacked upcoming festive line-up. In the exclusive image of the upcoming My Secret Santa , scheduled to debut on December 3, fans are treated to Cross star Ryan Eggold as Matthew and Sister, Sister ’s Tia Mowry as Natascha in conversation outside a luxury ski resort. Directed by Mike Rohl of The Princess Switch fame and penned by the duo of Carley Smale and Ron Oliver , My Secret Santa also stars Alexandra Breckenridge , Madison MacIsaac, and Diana Maria Riva. Get all the details about My Secret Santa in our exclusive look. 'Murder at the Embassy' Release Date: In Theaters Now Whilst you wait for the next Knives Out movie (more on that later), there's an enticing crime waiting to be solved in theaters and on digital platforms. That mystery is the heart of Murder at the Embassy , a film that follows the Agatha Christie -loving Miranda Green, played by The O. star Mischa Barton , as she is called to investigate a murder at the British Embassy. However, she soon starts unraveling a second crime that could have catastrophic global consequences. As part of Collider's Exclusive Winter Preview Event, we debuted the image above, showcasing Barton's crime-solver surrounded by ancient Egyptian relics. A sequel to 2023's Invitation to a Murder , the movie is directed by Stephen Shimek and penned by Mark Brennan. Get all the details about Murder at the Embassy in our exclusive look. 'Last Samurai Standing' Now streaming on Netflix last-samarai-standing-netflix Netflix's latest series, Last Samurai Standing , is set during the end of an era, as fallen samurais are warped into a violent game called Kodoku. What draws them into this competition is the opportunity to win a cash prize that could be their key to overcoming poverty and surviving a cholera outbreak. However, the catch is that only one samurai will make it out alive, and based on the exclusive picture above, we have our theories on who that might be. With a premise reminiscent to that of Squid Game , Last Samurai Standing is an action-packed, Japanese production that will leave you on edge. Get all the details about Last Samurai Standing in our exclusive preview. 'Thing With Feathers' Release Date: November 28, 2025 the-thing-with-feathers-benedict-cumberbatch Grief can come in various shapes and forms, and Thing With Feathers displays that full well. Based on Max Porter ’s novella, the film follows Dad ( Benedict Cumberbatch ) as he strives to keep it together for his young boys after his wife's death. One of the ways he copes with grief, is by getting even more focused on his work as a graphic novelist. In turn, one of his creations, a gigantic crow (voiced by David Thewlis ), leaves the page and becomes an ever-present figure in Dad's daily life. This unhinged and unwanted house guest turns out to be exactly what the protagonist needs to move forward. In addition to sharing an exclusive look at Cumberbatch's character alongside his two sons, we are sharing a new trailer. Get all the details about Thing With Feathers in our exclusive preview. ‘The King of Color’ Release Date: December 2025 It isn’t just fiction films and shows that get their place in Collider’s Winter Preview Event, as documentary fans are also treated to exclusives from the best and newest from the world of non-fiction. As part of our week of exclusives, we have debuted the above image from the upcoming documentary The King of Color , scheduled for release in December 2025. Directed by Patrick Creadon , this inspiring documentary looks at the life of Larry Herbert , the inventor of the Pantone Matching System, and uncovers the way in which he changed the universal language of color forever. The synopsis for the doc reads: “At 96 years old, Larry Herbert, known as THE KING OF COLOR, is a visionary whose revolutionary idea to standardize color remains largely unrecognized. Growing up in Depression-era Brooklyn, Larry entered the print and manufacturing trade during a time when color was a chaotic and subjective experience. He channeled his unique vision into creating the Pantone Matching System—a groundbreaking invention that established a universal language for color, profoundly enhancing artistic expression and commercial production across all industries. ” Get all the details about The King of Color in our exclusive look. 'The Things You Kill' Now in theaters This Turkish thriller explores the aftermath of revenge, when guilt and darkness take over. The Things You Kill follows Ali ( Ekin Koç ), a progressive university professor who is torn between academic work in Ankara and staying in a small town caring for his mother who is ill. As he wrestles between both options, his mother suspiciously dies, unlocking in Ali an inner rage he has been harboring against his father. This drives him toward revenge, recruiting his gardener to do the dirty work for him. The sneak peek above shows the moment in which Ali regrets what he did, and must live with the consequences. Get all the details about The Things You Kill in our exclusive look. 'Bunny' Now in select theaters and VOD Ben Jacobson might've been featured in High Fidelity and Blink Twice , but he is now ready to make his debut behind the camera. His film, Bunny , follows a hustler ( Mo Stark ) on a quick job until everything goes sideways. Unsure what to do, he requests the help of his best friend, Dino (Jacobson), and together they come up with an elaborate scheme to get rid of a dead body. With the police on the watch-out, Bunny's ultimate goal is to make it through the night without getting caught, or worse, killed. As chaos reigns and the clock ticks, the duo must rely on each other to carry on with their plan. Get all the details about Bunny in our exclusive preview. 'Riot Women' Release Date: January 14, 2026 It's not always that we get to see elderly women rocking the stage, but Riot Women proves that there are menopausal women who are still edgy. The series by Sally Wainwright , follows five women who create a punk-rock band to sign up for a local talent show. Yet, as they begin to work on music of their own, they notice that they have much more to say than they initially thought. With each of them undergoing their own struggles with romantic and familial relationships, the band becomes a catalyst for everything that they are going through. The sneak peek above marks a significant moment in the band's conception, giving U. audiences a taste of what they can anticipate from the series. Get all the details about Riot Women in our exclusive preview. 'The Housemaid' Release Date: December 19, 2025 Sydney Sweeney and Amanda Seyfried are two of the best-known actors working today, so a team-up between the two is sure to demand attention. This December 19, you can catch Sweeney and Seyfried in the upcoming thriller, The Housemaid , an adaptation of Freida McFadden​​​​​' s book, directed by Paul Feig , with this story tonally similar to his previous work on A Simple Favor and its sequel, Another Simple Favor. Also starring 1923 's Brandon Sklenar , Michele Morrone, and Elizabeth Perkins , the film follows a woman escaping her past who finds security in a new position as a live-in housemaid, only for a seductive scandal to unleash chaos. Ahead of the movie's arrival, Collider debuted the above image of Sweeney and Seyfried as housemaid Millie and the wealthy Nina, as part of our Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about The Housemaid in our exclusive look. ‘Come See Me in the Good Light’ Release Date: Available Now ComeSeeMeInTheGoodLight_Film_F10636F_APPLETV Apple TV might be home to some of the best fiction on television, but the streamer also plays host to a selection of fantastic and often life-changing documentaries. Released this past Friday, Ryan White ’s Come See Me in the Good Light “is a poignant and unexpectedly funny love story about poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley facing an incurable cancer diagnosis with joy, wit and an unshakable partnership. ” In the face of tragedy, this heartwarming partnership proves utterly life-affirming in a documentary you won’t want to miss. As part of Collider’s Exclusive Winter Preview Event, we debuted a brand-new image from the doc showcasing this loving partnership looking beyond. Get all the details about Come See Me in the Good Light and read an interview with the director in our exclusive look. ‘The Hunt’ Release Date: December 3, 2025 the-hunt-traques-season-1-episode-2-apple-tv Apple TV have produced some of 2025’s finest content, with their new series Pluribus yet another string to their acclaimed bow. This December, they will widen their impressive collection of enticing international content with The Hunt ( Traqués ) , the upcoming French-language thriller from the César-nominated Cédric Anger ( Next Time I’ll Aim for the Heart ). Ahead of the show’s December 3 premiere, with two episodes dropping at once on the streamer, Collider teamed with Apple TV to bring this exclusive image from the series as part of our Exclusive Winter Preview Event. The image features four of the series’ stars, Manuel Guillot , Frédéric Maranber , Cédric Appietto , and Damien Bonnard. Get all the details about The Hunt in our exclusive look. 'Rental Family' Release Date: November 21, 2025 Three years after winning his first Oscar for Best Actor in Darren Aronofsky 's The Whale , the beloved Brendan Fraser is back with Rental Family , a heartwarming comedy-drama from 37 Seconds and Beef director Hikari. Following Fraser as Phillip Vandarploeug, an American man in Tokyo searching for meaning and finding it in the most unlikely of places, Rental Family originally premiered at this year's Toronto International Film Festival, with Collider's Ross Bonaime calling it "a gentle, pleasant story that will surprise you with its affecting narrative. " Ahead of the movie's release on November 21, we debuted an exclusive clip, available to view above, as part of our Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about Rental Family in our exclusive look. 'GOAT' Release Date: February 13, 2026 goat-animated-movie It wasn't going to be long before the basketball 'G. T' debate was to be turned into an animated animal adventure. Scheduled for release on February 13, 2026, Sony Pictures Animation, the team behind Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse , brings to the big screen the story of a young goat, Will (voiced by Stranger Things alum Caleb McLaughlin ), who dreams of becoming a professional roarball player. However, all the best roarball players come from the bigger and faster animals in the kingdom, with Will having to overcome the odds to achieve his dream. Ahead of the movie's release, Collider has released the above image as part of our Exclusive Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about GOAT in our exclusive look. 'Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die' Release Date: February 13, 2026 What if the only way to combat AI is to enlist ordinary people to come to the rescue? That is what Sam Rockwell 's character does in Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die. In the film, he plays a mysterious man who claims to be from a future devastated by an evil AI. In order to stop it from causing further harm, he recruits late-night diner strangers to help him save the world. The exclusive image above shows Rockwell in a circle alongside the strangers he has allied with. Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die is the latest directorial effort by Gore Verbinski , the same mind behind the nerve-wracking horror film, A Cure for Wellness. Get all the details about Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die in our exclusive preview. ‘No Other Choice’ Release Date: December 25, 2025 One of the hottest movies leaving this year’s Toronto International Film Festival , No Other Choice is the latest project from acclaimed filmmaker Park Chan-wook. The man behind Oldboy and Decision to Leave is bringing thrills and comedic spills to a limited theatrical release this Christmas Day, with No Other Choice , the film selected as the South Korean entry for the Best International Feature Film at the upcoming 98th Academy Awards. Ahead of the movie’s release, Collider can exclusively debut the clip above as part of our Winter Preview Event. In a previous review of the film , Ross Bonaime called it “a contender for best comedy of the year,” and awarded it 9/10. Get all the details about No Other Choice in our exclusive look. 'Song Sung Blue' Release Date: December 25, 2025 hugh-jackman-kate-hudson-song-sung-blue Musical biopic fans are in for a real festive treat this Christmas Day, as Song Sung Blue premieres in theaters. Starring the ever-brilliant duo of Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson , the film follows a pair of down-on-their-luck musicians who chase their dreams and form Lightning and Thunder , a tribute band to the great Neil Diamond ​​​​. Also starring the likes of Michael Imperioli , Ella Anderson , King Princess , Mustafa Shakir , Hudson Hensley , Fisher Stevens , and more, the film promises a heartwarming sing-along you won't want to miss. Ahead of its Christmas Day release, Collider debuted the joyous image above as part of our Exclusive Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about Song Sung Blue in our exclusive look. 'The Abandons' Release Date: December 4, 2025 lena-headey-abandons-netflix Set in 1854, The Abandons follows two matriarchs from two very distinct families trying to make their way in the untamed Washington Territory. Fiona Nolan's ( Lena Headey ) found family is bound by love and necessity, whereas Constance Van Ness' ( Gillian Anderson ) family is bound by wealth and privilege passed on from one generation to the next. In spite of their differences, their fate is linked by two crimes, an awful secret, a star-crossed love, and a piece of land with silver underneath. The exclusive image above shows Fiona and her family of outcasts riding their horses and seemingly fighting for justice. Get all the details about The Abandons in our exclusive preview. 'Nouvelle Vague' Now streaming on Netflix NOUVELLE_VAGUE_netflix Richard Linklater 's tribute to French cinema is finally available to stream, after garnering praise throughout its festival run. Nouvelle Vague reimagines the making of Jean-Luc Godard 's Breathless , showing how the critic-turned-director (played by Guillaume Marbeck ) became the pioneer of the French New Wave. From Longlegs to The Monkey , Perkins has delivered sizzling horror with plenty of memorable scares. Now he’s back with another spine-chiller, reuniting with The Monkey ’s Tatiana Maslany for Keeper. Ahead of the movie’s theatrical release on November 14, Collider have teamed up with the Keeper team to bring you this exclusive image, showcasing a woman in unspeakable distress, as part of our Winter Preview Event. A synopsis for the movie reads: “A wife becomes isolated in a secluded cabin and has to fend off an unspeakable evil. ” Get all the details about Keeper in our exclusive look. 'Fackham Hall' Release Date: December 5, 2025 The Brits certainly know how to throw a period party, with the likes of Downton Abbey and The Gilded Age proving enormous hits. This December, get ready for the next must-see British period piece, although this time it's a spoof of the genre that "crosses Downton Abbey with Airplane! and Monty Python. " Starring Ben Radcliffe ( The Witcher ), Thomasin McKenzie ( Jojo Rabbit ), and Harry Potter 's Tom Felton , Fackham Hall follows Radcliffe's pick-pocket as he has the chance of a lifetime to steal to his heart's content after getting a job at a manor house, only for a murder to throw a spanner in the works. As part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted an exclusive clip from the film showcasing British comedy favorite Jimmy Carr delivering a hilarious sermon as a vicar. Get all the details about Fackham Hall in our exclusive look. 'Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie' Release Date: February 13, 2026 Matt Johnson and Jay McCarrol were not only responsible for the mokumentary series that followed their fictionalized selves trying to make it big with their improvisational piano and spoken-word group Nirvanna the Band, but they are also bringing their misadventures to the big screen.
